title: Jumli language
description: Indo-Aryan language of Eastern Pahari branch spoken in Nepal
extract: Jumli or Jumli Khas is an Indo-Aryan language of Nepal closely related to Nepali. It is primarily spoken in Jumla district and surroundings district in the Karnali Province of Nepal. The language is occasionally referred to as a dialect of Nepali; however, the Government of Nepal considers Jumli as a different language. The numbers of native speakers estimated 40,000. The Khas language is known as the parent language of Nepali language.
